tool_calls.text: /bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' /Users/garry/repo-skills-gen/home/.codex/skills/.system/skill-creator/SKILL.md && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && rg --files -g '"'!target'"' -g '"'!**/.git/**'"' | sed -n '1,240p'"

/bin/zsh -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- module poms ---' && for f in sm-shop/pom.xml sm-core/pom.xml sm-core-model/pom.xml sm-core-modules/pom.xml sm-shop-model/pom.xml; do echo \"### "'$f"; sed -n '"'1,260p' \""'$f"; done'
/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short && printf '\\n--- root pom ---\\n' && sed -n '1,280p' pom.xml"

/bin/zsh -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- README ---' && sed -n '1,260p' README.md && printf '%s\\n' '--- app config ---' && sed -n '1,260p' sm-shop/src/main/resources/application.properties && printf '%s\\n' '--- source entrypoints ---' && rg -n \"SpringBootApplication|public static void main|@SpringBootTest|@WebMvcTest|MockMvc|RestTemplate|TestRestTemplate|server.port|context-path|@ControllerAdvice|ResponseStatusException|@ExceptionHandler\" sm-shop/src sm-core/src sm-core-model/src sm-core-modules/src sm-shop-model/src | sed -n '1,320p'"

/bin/zsh -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- pom command-related ---' && rg -n -C 3 \"maven-surefire|failsafe|spring-boot-maven|jacoco|maven-compiler|<profiles>|<profile>|<skipTests>|<test>\" pom.xml sm-*/pom.xml"

/bin/zsh -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- app/config ---' && sed -n '1,220p' sm-shop/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/shop/application/ShopApplication.java && sed -n '1,240p' sm-shop/src/main/resources/application.properties && sed -n '1,240p' sm-shop/src/test/resources/application-test.properties && printf '%s\\n' '--- test support ---' && sed -n '1,260p' sm-shop/src/test/java/com/salesmanager/test/shop/common/ServicesTestSupport.java"

/bin/zsh -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- exceptions ---' && sed -n '1,240p' sm-shop/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/shop/store/api/exception/RestErrorHandler.java && for f in sm-shop/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/shop/store/api/exception/{RestApiException,ResourceNotFoundException,UnauthorizedException,ConstraintException,OperationNotAllowedException,ServiceRuntimeException,GenericRuntimeException,ConversionRuntimeException,ErrorEntity}.java; do echo \"### "'$f"; sed -n '"'1,180p' \""'$f"; done'

/bin/zsh -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- sample controller/service/repository flow ---' && sed -n '1,280p' sm-shop/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/shop/store/api/v1/customer/CustomerApi.java && sed -n '1,260p' sm-core/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/core/business/services/customer/CustomerService.java && sed -n '1,220p' sm-core/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/core/business/services/customer/CustomerServiceImpl.java && rg -n \"interface .*Repository|@Repository|extends .*Repository|@Service|@RestController|@Controller\" sm-core/src/main/java sm-core-model/src/main/java sm-shop-model/src/main/java sm-shop/src/main/java | sed -n '1,260p'"

/bin/zsh -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- test classes ---'; rg --files sm-core/src/test sm-shop/src/test | sort; printf '%s\\n' '--- representative integration tests ---'; sed -n '1,180p' sm-shop/src/test/java/com/salesmanager/test/shop/integration/system/ActuatorTest.java; sed -n '1,180p' sm-shop/src/test/java/com/salesmanager/test/shop/integration/store/MerchantStoreApiIntegrationTest.java; sed -n '1,150p' sm-core/src/test/java/com/salesmanager/test/customer/CustomerTest.java"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '460,560p' pom.xml; printf '\\n--- all build/test plugin references ---\\n'; rg -n -C 5 \"artifactId>maven-(surefire|failsafe|compiler|jar|resources)-plugin|artifactId>spring-boot-maven-plugin|<skip|<includes|<excludes|<testSourceDirectory\" pom.xml sm-*/pom.xml"

/bin/zsh -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- configuration classes ---'; rg -l \"class ConfigurationTest|interface ConfigurationTest\" . -g '*.java' | xargs -r -n1 sh -c 'echo \"### "'$0"; sed -n "1,280p" "$0"'"'; printf '%s\\n' '--- spring config resources ---'; find sm-core/src/test/resources sm-shop/src/test/resources sm-core/src/main/resources -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort | sed -n '1,240p'"

/bin/zsh -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- application config/profile references ---'; rg -n -C 3 \"spring\\.profiles|spring\\.datasource|jdbc:h2|database\\.properties|shopizer-core|ConfigurationTest|@ActiveProfiles|@TestPropertySource\" sm-*/src/main sm-*/src/test | sed -n '1,360p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- files at root and targets ---'; find . -maxdepth 2 -type d -name target -o -maxdepth 2 -type f -name '*.jar' | sort; find . -maxdepth 2 -type f -name 'mvnw' -o -name 'mvnw.cmd' | sort"
/bin/zsh -lc 'mvn -o test'
/bin/zsh -lc 'mvn -o -pl sm-shop -am -Dtest=ActuatorTest test'
/bin/zsh -lc 'mvn -o -pl sm-shop -am -Dtest=ActuatorTest -DfailIfNoTests=false test'
/bin/zsh -lc 'mvn -o -pl sm-shop -am spring-boot:run'
/bin/zsh -lc 'mvn -o spring-boot:run'

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,190p' sm-core/src/main/resources/spring/shopizer-core-config.xml; printf '\\n--- database properties ---\\n'; for f in sm-shop/src/main/resources/profiles/local/database.properties sm-shop/src/main/resources/profiles/dependency/database.properties sm-shop/src/test/resources/database.properties sm-core/src/test/resources/database.properties; do echo \"### "'$f"; sed -n '"'1,180p' \""'$f"; done; printf '"'\\n--- profile selectors ---\\n'; rg -n -C 4 \"profile|environment|database.properties|shopizer-core-config\" sm-shop/src/main sm-core/src/main | sed -n '1,360p'"
/bin/zsh -lc 'mvn -o spring-boot:run -Dspring-boot.run.classpathScope=test'
/bin/zsh -lc 'mvn -o -DskipTests package'

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' sm-core/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/core/business/services/customer/CustomerService.java; sed -n '1,360p' sm-core/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/core/business/services/customer/CustomerServiceImpl.java; sed -n '1,180p' sm-core/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/core/business/repositories/customer/CustomerRepository.java; sed -n '1,260p' sm-core-model/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/core/model/customer/Customer.java"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,300p' sm-shop/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/shop/store/api/v1/customer/CustomerApi.java; printf '\\n--- facade ---\\n'; sed -n '1,280p' sm-shop-model/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/shop/store/controller/customer/facade/v1/CustomerFacade.java; printf '\\n--- implementation ---\\n'; rg -l \"class CustomerFacadeImpl\" sm-shop/src sm-shop-model/src | xargs -r -n1 sh -c 'echo \"### "'$0"; sed -n "1,300p" "$0"'"'"

/bin/zsh -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- security and error controllers ---'; rg -n -C 4 \"@RequestMapping|@GetMapping|@PostMapping|@PutMapping|@PatchMapping|@DeleteMapping|throw new .*Exception|ResponseStatus\" sm-shop/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/shop/store/api/v1/customer/CustomerApi.java sm-shop/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/shop/store/api/v1/customer/AuthenticateCustomerApi.java sm-shop/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/shop/store/controller/error/ShopErrorController.java sm-shop/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/shop/store/security | sed -n '1,360p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- shared symbol usage examples ---'; rg -n \"CustomerService|CustomerFacade|RestErrorHandler|ErrorEntity\" sm-core sm-shop sm-shop-model -g '*.java' | sed -n '1,360p'"

/bin/zsh -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- facade contracts ---'; for f in sm-shop/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/shop/store/controller/customer/facade/CustomerFacade.java sm-shop/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/shop/store/controller/customer/facade/CustomerFacadeImpl.java sm-shop/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/shop/store/facade/customer/CustomerFacadeImpl.java; do echo \"### "'$f"; sed -n '"'1,220p' \""'$f"; done; printf '"'%s\\n' '--- core service ---'; sed -n '1,180p' sm-core/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/core/business/services/customer/CustomerService.java; sed -n '1,240p' sm-core/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/core/business/services/customer/CustomerServiceImpl.java; printf '%s\\n' '--- repository ---'; sed -n '1,180p' sm-core/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/core/business/repositories/customer/CustomerRepository.java; printf '%s\\n' '--- status ---'; git status --short"
/bin/zsh -lc 'git restore -- sm-shop/files/store/DownlaodRepository.dat && git status --short'

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,160p' sm-shop/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/shop/store/controller/error/ShopErrorController.java; printf '\\n--- base service/repository structure ---\\n'; sed -n '1,220p' sm-core/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/core/business/services/common/generic/SalesManagerEntityServiceImpl.java; sed -n '1,160p' sm-core/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/core/business/repositories/catalog/product/ProductRepositoryCustom.java; printf '\\n--- test inventory by module ---\\n'; find sm-core/src/test/java sm-shop/src/test/java -type f -name '*Test.java' | sort"
/bin/zsh -lc "git diff -- AGENTS.md .agents/skills/build-test/SKILL.md .agents/skills/verify-api/SKILL.md .agents/skills/safe-change/SKILL.md | sed -n '1,360p'"
/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"CustomerService|CustomerFacade\" sm-core sm-shop sm-shop-model -g '*.java' >/dev/null && git diff --check && git status --short"

/bin/zsh -lc 'python3 /Users/garry/repo-skills-gen/home/.codex/skills/.system/skill-creator/scripts/quick_validate.py .agents/skills/build-test && python3 /Users/garry/repo-skills-gen/home/.codex/skills/.system/skill-creator/scripts/quick_validate.py .agents/skills/verify-api && python3 /Users/garry/repo-skills-gen/home/.codex/skills/.system/skill-creator/scripts/quick_validate.py .agents/skills/safe-change'

/bin/zsh -lc "git diff >/dev/null; sed -n '1,220p' AGENTS.md; for f in .agents/skills/*/SKILL.md; do echo \"--- "'$f"; sed -n '"'1,260p' \""'$f"; done; printf '"'\\n--- final status ---\\n'; git status --short; printf '\\n--- requested files ---\\n'; rg --files AGENTS.md .agents | sort"
